---
game-name: "Chronicles of the Ember Coast"
---
A charred wand of rowan that holds seven sparks. Speak its command word
to loose one as a mote of fire that lights a candle, a fuse or a cloak.
Once a day, at dawn, it regains every spark it has spent.

```cardsmith
  system: simple
  card-type: simple
  language: en

  tracker:
    - { count: 7, label: Charges }
    - { count: 3, label: Per long rest, group: 3 }
```
